audit.whatIsWrong: Six rows contradict their own whys[]. Levels 2, 3 and first item are given to Poppy while their whys describe Maokai out-trading her; Levels 4-5 and 6 are marked Skill while their whys say Maokai re-engages every few seconds and that R roots a dashless Poppy for a clean all-in; 2+ items is given to Poppy while late[] says outright 'From 2+ items it flattens to Skill'.
audit.why: Poppy is immobile outside Heroic Charge, so once Twisted Advance into Bramble Smash is online she cannot kite a step-up, and Sap Magic refunds the trade. At 6 Nature's Grasp catches a champion with no dash. The 55.56% win rate and the packet chart both match that reading.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 set to Maokai (6/10) and row 6 to Skill in both layers.

audit.why: Four spikes present: Lvl 2-3, Lvl 6, 1st item, Lvl 9+ as her wall-pin burst window. All consistent with the corrected chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions that decide this lane are absent from the full layer. Steadfast Presence is never named there, and nothing states that Keeper's Verdict is a channel — dontsFull[1] is titled 'Get R-knocked mid-combo' with a description about burning an ability for tiny value.
audit.why: Steadfast Presence carries the dash-stop: Riot's text says it stops enemy dashes around her, and a stopped dash is slowed and grounded. That is a hard counter to Twisted Advance, and its 20/18/16/14/12s cooldown is the real window to attack, not Heroic Charge's. Keeper's Verdict has the 'channel: interruptible' flag — Maokai's Q knockback or W root cancels a 140s ultimate outright, which is the single biggest swing available to him in this matchup.
audit.corrected: phases[3].why now states the dash-stop with its 20s rank-1 cooldown; dontsFull[1].d states the channel interrupt.

audit.whatIsWrong: The file tracks Heroic Charge as the matchup-defining cooldown, but never gives its duration, and it is arguably the wrong ability to track.
audit.why: Heroic Charge is 14/13/12/11/10s. Steadfast Presence at 20/18/16/14/12s is the longer and more punishing one for Maokai specifically, because it denies his engage entirely rather than punishing his position. Both numbers now appear.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d carries Heroic Charge's 14s; phases[3].why carries Steadfast Presence's 20s.

edits.before: Passive heal + AA trades carry the early waves. Identify how Poppy contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: One ability and no combo, and her Q zone punishes a wall-side step — just farm and set the wave up for Level 2.

edits.before: W root is your engage AND your peel — spend it once per fight. Only take the trade when Poppy's Heroic Charge is down.
edits.after: W-root into Q-knockback comes online and Sap Magic heals the trade — an immobile Poppy cannot kite your step-up.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Poppy must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: W, Q and E let you repeat the root-poke-heal trade; one Hammer Shock zone cannot match that sustained pressure.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Heroic Charge's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Trade when Steadfast Presence is down — it stops your W dash outright and grounds you, and it is a 20s cooldown at rank 1.

edits.before: Nature’s Grasp roots whole teams — lane it only for kill windows. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Poppy's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Nature's Grasp roots her and she has no dash to escape it, so W into R into Q is a clean all-in or gank setup she cannot slip.

edits.before: Heartsteel is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Heroic Charge's cooldown.
edits.after: Durable on the Bami line — every walk-up trade heals back faster than she can punish.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Poppy carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Your damage stops scaling and a fed Poppy E-pins you to a wall for burst — it flattens out, so lean on teamfight utility.

edits.before: Wall-pin stun. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Wall-pin stun, 14s at rank 1. Commit once it is down or baited.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Keeper's Verdict is a channel — your Q or W root cancels it outright.

notes: The best find here is Keeper's Verdict being an interruptible channel: Maokai's Q knockback cancels a 140s ultimate, and the file's 'don't' about it said nothing of the kind. Second: Steadfast Presence stops dashes and grounds the dasher — it hard-denies Twisted Advance, so it is the cooldown Maokai should actually be counting, not Heroic Charge. Six chart rows flipped in matched pairs to agree with the file's own whys[] and late[].
